verdict.rationale: Retell's docs show that it stores per-call transcripts and recordings (the data-retention docs name both). Its webhooks push call_ended and call_analyzed events to your server, and its SDKs claim full voice endpoint coverage, so programmatic call-data access is documented. No item explicitly documents an API endpoint or webhook payload that returns the recording file or full transcript for every call. Missing for 10: an explicit get-call or list-calls API returning recording URLs and transcripts, documented webhook payload contents including transcript and recording, and independent or hands-on corroboration of retrieval.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call

citations.quote: automatically delete call and chat data — transcripts, recordings, and logs
call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling
webhooks push data to your application as events happen
full voice and chat endpoint coverage
